title: Remote driving
definition: Real-time performance of part or all of the DDT or the DDT fallback, including braking, steering and acceleration, by a remote driver who completes the object and event detection and response and may overrule the automated driving system. EU type-approval law leaves it outside the ADS framework; German law confines the technical supervision to releasing manoeuvres and, after a defect, to near-field manual control at walking speed within six metres. The Observatory codes remote driving as its own column so that a supervisor or intervention role is never mistaken for a remote driver.
